"""JSONL driver for the extended SyncWise computational system."""
import os
os.environ['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS']='1'
os.environ['OMP_NUM_THREADS']='1'
import json
import sys
import algo
import para
from simulator import Simulator

def dispatch(request):
    op=request['op']
    if op=='calibrate':return para.calibrate(request['profile'])
    if op=='plan':return algo.compile_plan(request['profile'],request['fabric'])
    if op=='audit':return algo.audit(request['profile'],request['fabric'],request['proposal'])
    engine=Simulator.from_contract(request['profile'],request['fabric'])
    engine.guard_ns=request['guard_ns'];engine.trace=request['trace']
    return engine.run(iter=request['trace']['rounds'])

for line in sys.stdin:
    if line.strip():print(json.dumps(dispatch(json.loads(line)),separators=(',',':')),flush=True)
